page.layout: One page of text in a single column; printed page number at top right; running head at top centre; numbered marginal references (195–204) at the right edge beside the lines; catchword-like mark at foot right.

main_text.p: à gratia non obstantibus omnibus munimentis possessionalibus: cadit à possessione & dominio.
Nec in proprio, nec in communi, debet clerici ciuiliter dominari.197
Quando clericus repetit in foro cötentiosō, vel facit aliquid cōtra contra Christi consilia, ex certa scientia: peccat mortaliter.198
Loqui uerbum otiosum ex certa scientia: est peccatum mortale.199
Ira quantumlibet leuis ex passione animi nō pia intentione colendi Deum & ædificandi proximum, est peccatum mortale.200
Baptismus delet omne peccatū originale uel actuale, mortale, aut ueniale quod inuenit.201
Inutile est ut plurimum, cōdere testamētum.202

Omnes existentes in purgatorio, cōmunicati ue participant meritaecclesiæ proportionaliter secundum suā capacitatē, sic quòd qui decessit in maiori gratia, magis participat, et citius liberatur. Et ideo diuites mundi errāt, putantes habere de bonis ab executoribus suis appropriate suffragium, contigit enim pauperes executoribus illis incognitos plus illis participare ex quo apud Deum fuerunt Domini ueriores.203
Prælato quem subditi improbum iudicant, probabiliter ex vita sua, non debent retribuere204

page.notes: Marginal numbers 197–204 are the printed side references. Long s rendered as s; the ligature-like "&" and "cῦ" abbreviations kept as printed. Some words in the lower half are doubtful, especially "probabiliter" and the line ending "retribuere". Catchword-like signature "Cc ij" at foot right.
